description: This file defines a SwiftUI view called SkillsSettings for managing and displaying skills in the application, along with associated models, subviews, and utility structures. It includes logic for fetching skill statuses, updating environment variables, enabling/disabling skills, and installing skills, primarily interacting with GatewayConnection for backend operations.

classes.name: SkillsSettingsModel
classes.description: An observable class managing the state and interactions for skill statuses, including refresh, update environment variables, enable/disable skills, and install skills.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches current skill statuses from the backend and updates the local skills array.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Installs a specified skill with given options on the selected target, possibly switching connection mode.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a skill based on the provided skillKey and enabled boolean.

methods.name: updateEnv
methods.description: Updates the environment variables or API key for a specific skill.
